Minister Salary
You join the public service. The formula that sets the Prime Minister's pay is published, and so is the distance between you and it.

Your name: Jia Hui (Female)
You chose: Poly, then night classes (HARD)
Diploma, four years working a public service counter, and a part-time degree you're finishing at night. You start as a Management Executive, and you know how the counter actually works.

One tap is one year, and every year ends with an appraisal grade. A or B+ gets you considered for promotion; two Ds in a row and you are asked to leave. Choices are permanent, and some of them come back.
